convert_audio_sample_rate_and_channels: convert a PyTorch audio tensor to a new sample rate and channel count using julius resampling
normalize_audio_with_peak_strategy: normalize a PyTorch audio tensor using peak, RMS, clip, or loudness normalization strategies with configurable headroom
normalize_loudness_itu_r_bs1770: normalize audio loudness to a target LUFS level following the ITU-R BS.1770-4 recommendation with optional tanh soft clipping
compress_audio_to_mp3_ogg_flac: compress a PyTorch audio tensor to MP3, OGG, or FLAC format at a specified bitrate and return the decoded tensor
convert_audio_batch_to_aac: convert a batch of audio tensors to AAC format via FFmpeg with configurable bitrate and optional low-pass filter
